pages.text: As time passes, so now do the seasons.$(br)Seasons affect the weather and ambient $(l:changes_to_vanilla/temperature#temp1)temperature$(), grass & foliage colour. $(br2)In temperate biomes there are four 24-day seasons (spring, summer, autumn, winter) and in dry or tropical biomes there are two 48-day seasons (wet, dry).
